changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6247-option-visiblewhen-metadata-admin.md`

- names `SchemaForm.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Three consuming controls now filter, and each has a pin asserting an option **absent** on a false predicate: the builtin Select in `SchemaForm.tsx`, `MultiSelectWidget`, and `colorPaletteOptions` → `ColorSwatchGroupWidget`. Asserting absence is the whole of the test design — this evaluator fails OPEN, so "the option is shown" is equally the outcome of predicate-true, predicate-never-arrived and predicate-faulted, and a positive-only pin passes against the unfixed renderer.

### `.changeset/console-form-container-specs-one-declaration-5596.md`

- names `SchemaForm.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > objectui#5542 converged the LEAF of this contract — the field spec — and left the two containers above it untouched, because converging them was a bigger call than a mechanical import. `FormSectionSpec` and `FormViewSpec` were each hand-declared twice under the same names, once in `packages/app-shell`'s `SchemaForm.tsx` and once in `apps/console`'s `FormPage.tsx`. Unlike the leaf — whose console copy was a clean subset — these two had **already drifted, in both directions**, so neither copy was a subset of the other and there were two live answers to "what may an author write":

### `.changeset/formfieldspec-dependson-5040.md`

- names `SchemaForm.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > No runtime behaviour changes: `MetadataField` already handed `dependsOn` through and both widgets already read it. What changes is the type face — it now admits what the runtime has always accepted. The two descriptions are one declaration, extracted to a leaf module (`views/metadata-admin/form-spec.ts`) that both halves import, because `SchemaForm.tsx` imports `./widgets.js` and a back-edge would close a cycle. `SchemaForm.tsx` re-exports `FormFieldSpec` and `VisibilityPredicate`, so every existing importer is unaffected.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f16c01e90` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1849 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2461 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36783701647)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2082cb00b2ba51e6adfdb5018c000f4ada2f9f27`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

**Inputs and gate verdicts.** Card #11251 (body; triage `5917836441`, claim `5919281525`, dev report `5920910481`); coupled card #10239 (body; all six comments, including its dev report `5916952580` and seat 1's release `5917056769`); PR #11277 (body, the 3-file list, the diff against `main` at the head, the PR's own comments `5920570625` and `5920591799`); the head's check-runs with `filter=latest`: 43 runs, all completed — 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (Test (coverage), Test (coverage shard), dependabot: conditional jobs), 0 in progress. Type Check, Lint, Test shards 1–8, Test, Test (dist pins), Build & E2E, Changeset Declaration / Bump Policy / Fixed Group Check / Overwrite Report / Claim Re-read, Line Citation Gate, Control Byte Scan, Governed Surface Queue Guard: `success`. Context read through `contents?ref=` only: `SchemaForm.tsx`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `MetadataDetailDrawer.tsx`, `src/index.ts`, `SchemaForm.repeaterUnion.test.tsx`, `SchemaForm.nestedAnyOfPredicate-9830.test.tsx` and the three pending changesets at the head; objectstack `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` and `view.form.ts` at `0f6dcac5e9` (the 17.5.0 tag commit); `compare/4a9380847...2082cb00b`.

**The declared deviation (dev report deviation 1) — judged first. Right, with the moves named.**
- One function, `resolveUnionBranch` (`SchemaForm.tsx:344`), and its call sites are the old ones plus one: `repeaterItemSchema` (:428, :435), `resolveFieldFace` (:848, :854), the new `SchemaFormBody` call (:1199). Not a second resolver: `unionMembers` is a pre-pass on the branch list and `valueContradictions` is one more key in the same ranking loop. Triage's ⛔ against a second resolver holds.
- Ranking now: `kind` (a `type` that fits the value), then fewest contradictions, then `rest` (the items-type tiebreak plus `required` keys present), then declaration order. Before: the single sum `kind + rest`, declaration order on ties. Where contradictions tie, the lexicographic (kind, rest) equals the old sum unless a branch with no fitting `type` carries at least six more present `required` keys than a typed sibling; the head's comment (:332–:335) names that shape as absent from every served derivation. `valueContradictions` is 0 for every non-object value, an empty object, and any branch without `properties`, so scalar, array and empty-value picks are the old ones.
- Values whose branch MOVES for an existing caller, each judged right:
  1. A field-level object union on a partial draft whose named discriminator the old tie ignored. `ViewDataSchema` (`view.zod.ts:162`, four strict arms discriminated on `provider`): `data: { provider: 'api' }` (likewise `'value'`, `'schema'`) resolved before to the FIRST arm, `object` (every arm scored 1 for `provider`; tie, declaration order), and resolves now to the `api` arm (0 contradictions against the `object` arm's 2: `const` mismatch, missing `object`). The old pick rendered the wrong provider's form; the move is the correction. A complete value (`{ provider: 'object', object: 'x' }`) and a provider-less draft (`{ object: 'x' }`) pick as before.
  2. A bare nested union at a field. The dev's one-time scan places these only at the `view` top level and at the `visible` / `disabled` predicate slots of `action` and object actions (input derivation) — the shape `SchemaForm.nestedAnyOfPredicate-9830.test.tsx` fixes (`anyOf: [boolean, anyOf: [string, envelope]]`). With a string value the resolved `effective` was the boolean arm (nothing fit, first branch) and is now the string arm. No face moves: those keys render through the registered condition widget, which `resolveFieldFace` returns before it reads `effective` (:863–:866), and `FieldControl` hands a registered widget the raw `schema` (:2165). The 9830 pin is green on the head.
  3. Generic class, no served instance found by this review and none claimed by the dev: two object-typed branches where a partial draft of the richer one (one `required` key still missing) lands on the leaner one until that key is filled — a properties-bearing arm beside a `z.record` arm would do it. Bounded by the 368-file metadata-admin suite (4346 green at `4a9380847`) and by CI on the head; not a pin gap of this card. Named so the seat has it.
- Ablations C1 / C2 against the diff and the spec: C2 (no `unionMembers`) scores the ViewItem wrapper `{ oneOf: [list arm, form arm] }` as one typeless member (kind 0), so a stored ViewItem falls to the list overlay (kind 5) and the ViewItem pin's null assertions on `type` / `columns-label` / `searchableFields` go red — matches. C1 (no contradictions) leaves the flattened list overlay value to `rest`: the list overlay member requires the identity pair only (`listOverlayPatchFields`, `view.zod.ts:5974` — `columns` optional, `type` without its default), the form overlay member requires the pair plus `type` (`FormViewSchema.type` `.default('simple')`, :4191, hence `required` in the output derivation) and the value's `type: 'grid'` counts for it: 3 beats 2, the form overlay wins, `searchableFields` goes null — the list-overlay row goes red, matches. Necessity is measured for both, as claimed.
- The container pin (renamed in `2082cb00b`, rightly): under C1 the container value would land on the list ViewItem arm (rest 2: `name`, `object`), not on the list overlay, and through this door the two members render the same `name` / `label` controls, so that pin cannot tell the container member from the ViewItem arm. The container's own member is what `valueContradictions` reaches (container 0; ViewItem arms 3; overlays at least 1 for the missing `viewKind`) — judged from the spec, not from a red leg. A limit of what the pin can observe through the served `viewForm`, not a defect.

**Each stored shape lands on the member that keeps it.** Right. Against `ViewMetadataSchema` at `0f6dcac5e9` (`VIEW_METADATA_BRANCHES` order: viewItem, container, listOverlay, formOverlay; :6175):
- ViewItem `{ name, object, viewKind: 'list', label, config }`: list ViewItem arm 0 contradictions, rest 4; list overlay 0 contradictions (its `config` guard derives to `{}`, so no undeclared-key hit), rest 2 — the ViewItem arm wins. Its `properties` carry no `type`, `columns` or `searchableFields`, so the served `viewForm` renders those as missing-from-schema notices, never as controls: no top-level `columns` / `type` edit exists to be stripped on save. The pin asserts exactly that (`byId` null for all three).
- List overlay: list overlay 0 against the form overlay's at least 2 (`viewKind` enum, `type` enum) — `searchableFields`, `type` and the `columns` group are asserted present.
- Container `{ name, object, label, list }`: container (`ViewSchema`, strict, every key optional) 0; ViewItem arms 3 (`viewKind` and `config` missing, `list` undeclared on a closed arm); overlays at least 1 (`viewKind` required) — the container wins.
- Residual, named for the seat: the resolution runs on every render against the live draft, as every field-level caller of this resolver already does. On a stored ViewItem the one single-key edit that moves it is blanking `name` (rendered and not locked on an existing item; `ResourceEditPage.tsx:2828–:2864` hands the draft to `SchemaForm` unchanged): the form then transiently shows the list overlay's controls, and a top-level `columns` / `type` edit made inside that window survives the name being retyped (the closed ViewItem arm keeps 1 contradiction for that key against the overlay's 0) and is stripped by member 1 on save. Reach needs a deliberately blanked identity key plus an overlay-only edit inside that window; the stored-shape edit the card measures never reaches it. Not a breach of the direction, which was resolution against the value with this resolver.

**Top-level resolution only when the schema has no `properties` of its own.** Right: `SchemaFormBody` :1195–:1200 gates on `effectiveSchema.properties === undefined` and an `anyOf` / `oneOf` array, after `inlineSchemaRefs`. The control (`ListViewSchema`, top-level `properties`) is untouched: 9 ids and 2 object rows before and after.

**Scalar-row guard.** Right. `RepeaterField` receives `schema = { ...schema, items: face.itemSchema }` (:2117, :2209), where `face.itemSchema` is `repeaterItemSchema`'s pick — for `['name', 'status']` the array-of-strings arm (rest +3 on the first item), so `items.type === 'string'`. With rows present (:2691) each row is one `FieldControl` over the row value (id `mdf-columns.N`, named by the host label plus its own ordinal), `replace` keeps a cleared string row as `''`, and Add appends `''`. Empty value: `repeaterItemSchema` still picks the first arm (strings) but `rows.length === 0` skips the guard, so `add()` pushes the object row as before, after which the first row is an object and the object arm resolves. Object rows keep their declared sub-fields (`mdf-columns.1.field` / `.width` / `.label`). A stray object row in a scalar list gets `schema={}` (its JSON), never coercion. The three objectui#10239 pins assert each of these through `SchemaForm` over `ListViewSchema` — top-level `properties`, so independent of the union step. Ablation B (guard dropped) reds exactly the string-array row — matches.

**Pins and the four legs.** 8 tests in `SchemaForm.topLevelUnion-11251.test.tsx`: 1 fixture admissibility (the three bodies parse under `ViewMetadataSchema`; the served JSON has `anyOf` and no `properties`), 3 stored shapes through the real `MetadataDetailDrawer` mounting `MetadataResourceEditPage` embedded (mocked `useMetadata` serving `z.toJSONSchema(ViewMetadataSchema)` plus `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY.view`, Edit clicked, controls counted by `mdf-drawer-metadata.` id), 1 control, 3 for objectui#10239. Leg A (top-level call dropped) reds exactly the three view rows — the control and the 10239 rows do not depend on it — matches. All four legs are consistent with the diff, each red set as predicted.

**Public surface and accept set.** Nothing moves. `resolveUnionBranch` was module-private at the base and stays so (no `export` at :344; the diff's context line is unchanged). `resolveFieldFace` is a module export but not a package export: `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` exports `SchemaForm` and `MetadataResourceEditPage` from `metadata-admin` (:377, :382) and neither resolver. No type, prop, schema or registry entry changes; the curated designer (`VIEW_CURATED_FIELDS`, `FORM_FIELDS_OWNED_ELSEWHERE`, `ViewVariantInspector.tsx`) is not in the 3-file list. objectui#10239's guard and its three pins ride this PR, as the coupling binds.

**Declared narrowing.** Verified: `compare/4a9380847...2082cb00b` is one commit, three files — `SchemaForm.tsx` +8/−4 inside the resolver's JSDoc only (:329–:336), the pin file +3/−1 (one `it` title and a two-line comment), the changeset +2/−2 prose. No code moved, so the suite, the consumers and the type-check at `4a9380847` cover the head; the pin file, the 43-file subset, eslint and the check scripts were re-run at the head per the report, and CI is green on the head.
